column1: ! Nouns ending in з take the -дар/-дәр allomorph, like other voiced
! non-continuants. Surface forms below are attested in a 145M-character
! Bashkir corpus; the forms generated before the fix (заказлар, колхозла,
! призлар …) do not occur in it at all.
! Regression: the other consonant classes must keep their allomorphs.
! Word-final в is devoiced and takes the voiceless allomorphs, in the plural
! and in every case. Surface forms below are attested in a 145M-character
! Bashkir corpus; the forms generated before the fix (коллективҙа, архивҙан …)
! do not occur in it at all.
